name: admin-model-catalog-multi-provider
title: Admin model catalog multi-provider access
description: Implement and validate a provider-neutral model catalog so Admin can sync/select Venice models in addition to OpenRouter and published config can drive backend generation with dedicated Venice usage history.
creator: cline
notes: 2026-09-29 progress review: implementation and automated checks are substantially complete (~90%), but release validation remains. Keep in_progress until both migrations are applied/verified in TEST and real Admin OpenRouter/Venice directory plus Venice generation/failure smokes are recorded. Focused test gaps: provider-directory failure/stale paths, Admin provider switch/cross-provider duplicate behavior, Venice non-stream and usage-missing fallback.
